<div class="card-body">
'''Rogue Bantha''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Creature Vehicle]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">はぐれバンサ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2名までの乗客を追加できる。バンサは能力値＝1/2。“リアクション”として移動できる。屋外の位置カードで戦闘が行われたら、開始時に同じ場所にいるタスケン・レイダーを一名（どれにするかはこちらが選べる）“踏んづける”（即座にロストする）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rogue-Bantha-PSA-90960113.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダーの若者の扱いのまずさから、荒野に逃げ出してしまったバンサ。モイスチャー・ファーマーが手なずけたため、よそ者にもよくなつくが、タスケン・レイダーだけは見たとたんに攻撃し始める。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rogue Bantha.

'''Card text:'''
May add up to 2 passengers. Bantha ability equals 1/2. May move as a react. When a battle is fought at an exterior location card, at the start one Tusken Raider at the same place (your choice) is trampled (immediately lost).

'''Lore:'''
A bantha that fled into the wilderness after a young Tusken Raider handled it poorly. A moisture farmer tamed it, so it is friendly to strangers, but it attacks Tusken Raiders on sight.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says a moisture farmer tamed it (手なずけた); English says it was raised by a moisture farmer.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue Bantha]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
